        _create_block_mask = torch.compile(create_block_mask, dynamic=False)
    return _create_block_mask


def bench(model, batch, steps=5):
    tok = torch.randint(0, 257, (batch, SEQ + 1), device="cuda")
    loss = compute_loss(model, tok, LOOPS, torch.bfloat16)
    torch.autograd.backward(loss)
    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        torch.autograd.backward(loss)

    return batch * SEQ / dt, torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 2**30


orig_attn_forward = Attention.forward
orig_indexer_forward = SparseIndexer.forward
orig_fp4_forward = Fp4Linear.forward


def block_indexer_forward(self, x):
    # NSA-style: score key-blocks per query-block, build one BlockMask per step
    b, q, d = x.shape
    iq = self.index_q(x).view(b, q // BLOCK, BLOCK, -1).mean(2)
    ik = self.index_k(x).view(b, q // BLOCK, BLOCK, -1).mean(2)
    scores = functional.relu(torch.einsum("bqd,bkd->bqk", iq, ik))
    nb = q // BLOCK

    cmask = causal.view(1, nb, 1) >= causal.view(1, 1, nb)
    scores = scores.masked_fill(~cmask, float("-inf"))
    # diagonal (local) always on
    scores[:, causal, causal] = float("inf")
    k = min(TOP_BLOCKS, nb)
    idx = scores.topk(k, dim=-1).indices
    blocksel = torch.zeros(b, nb, nb, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device)
    blocksel = blocksel.scatter(-1, idx, True) & cmask

            self._fp4_delta = fp4mod.quantize_fp4(self.weight) - self.weight
